import sys
from collections import deque

def bfs(start, parent, visited, g):
    q = deque([start])
    visited[start] = True
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for v in g[u]:
            if not visited[v]:
                visited[v] = True
                parent[v] = u
                q.append(v)

def find_odd_cycle(n, g):
    visited = [False] * (n + 1)
    parent = [-1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if not visited[i]:
            bfs(i, parent, visited, g)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in g[i]:
            if parent[i] != j and parent[j] != i:
                path = []
                u = i
                while u != -1:
                    path.append(u)
                    u = parent[u]
                path.reverse()
                v = j
                while v != -1:
                    path.append(v)
                    v = parent[v]
                for k in range(len(path)):
                    if path[k] == j:
                        break
                cycle = path[k:]
                if len(cycle) % 2 == 1:
                    return True
    return False
